question: Ageless Sentinels becomes a Bird Giant and loses defender when it blocks. Once that has happened, can it attack on my later turns?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: once it stops being a Wall it can attack, because it also loses defender.
expected.answer: Once it stops being a Wall, it can attack because it also loses Defender.

whyHard: Players think a card printed with defender can never attack, forgetting that the effect removes the keyword.
